Config.todas_as_opcoes_do_calendario_da: Every Calendário da Mesa option organized in tabs: General, Time, Weather, Anomalies, Astronomy and light, Events and journals, and Tools.
Config.visual_do_hud_e_da_janela: Look of the HUD and the calendar window.
Config.o_d_d_5e_tem_o: D&D 5e has its own clock at the top of the screen. It shows this calendar's date; hide it to keep only the Calendário da Mesa HUD.
Config.esconder_usar_so_o_do_calendario: Hide (use only the Calendário da Mesa one)
Config.journal_da_mesa_nova_nota_cria: Journal da Mesa: "New note" creates the page and opens it in Journal da Mesa, where you edit the date, time, repetition, icon and alert. If Journal da Mesa is disabled, the calendar uses its own editor. Calendar: always the calendar's editor.
Config.abrir_notas_no_journal_da_mesa: Open notes in Journal da Mesa
Config.se_o_modulo_journal_da_mesa: If the Journal da Mesa module is active, calendar notes open in it instead of the default sheet.
Config.desligado_eles_veem_so_madrugada_manha: When off, they only see Before dawn, Morning, Afternoon or Night.
Config.dentro_da_pasta_escolhida_cada_nota: Inside the chosen folder, each note goes into a subfolder "Ano 1023", "Ano 1024"...
Config.jogadores_sabem_quando_uma_lua_volta: Players know when a moon returns
Config.no_painel_do_dia_mostra_as: In the day panel, shows the moons out of the sky and how long until they return.
Config.segundos_de_jogo_por_segundo_real: Game seconds per real second (1 = real time, 60 = one minute per second).
Config.relogio_para_quando_o_jogo_esta: Clock stops while the game is paused
Config.no_combate_o_foundry_ja_avanca: In combat, Foundry already advances time each round.
Config.nivel_de_luz_de_cada_hora: Light level for each hour, moonlight and night color. Applies to scenes with day/night turned on (half-moon button on the HUD).
Config.libera_o_botao_do_historico_da: Unlocks the campaign history button for players.
Config.mostra_a_aba_anomalias_na_janela: Shows the Anomalies tab in the weather window and makes anomalies take effect. Off: they disappear from the window, the HUD and the map Regions (the ones you created are kept).
Config.ligado_da_para_ativar_uma_anomalia: On: an anomaly can cover a whole region (Temperate, Water Realm...) from the weather window and from Journal da Mesa Nexus thresholds. Off (default): the anomaly only applies in its own region ("Use as region" in the Anomalies tab), and the Nexus turn that region on and off.
Config.usada_nas_cenas_que_nao_escolheram: Used in scenes that haven't chosen a region (weather button on the HUD).
Config.nevoa_de_guerra_com_o_dia: Fog of war with day and night
Config.nas_cenas_com_dia_noite_do: In scenes with Calendar day/night: by day the map is bright and visible (global light); when darkness passes the limit below, each player only sees lit areas, the character's darkvision range and, dimmed, what they have already explored. Turns on token vision and fog exploration in those scenes.
Config.ligar_a_visao_dos_tokens_dos: Turn on vision for player tokens
Config.sem_visao_ativada_no_token_o: Without "Vision Enabled" on the token, the player sees only black by day and by night, even with darkvision on the sheet. With this on, the calendar enables vision on tokens of player characters in day/night scenes (those already on the map and new ones). The range still comes from the token or, in D&D 5e, from the senses on the sheet.
Config.de_dia_mapa_aberto_para_todos: By day, map open to everyone
Config.de_dia_a_visao_dos_tokens: By day token vision is turned off: everyone sees the whole map, even players with no token in the scene (good for world maps). Walls hide nothing and nothing is explored during the day. At night token vision comes back. Off (default): by day each player sees what their token can reach, with walls blocking.
Config.escuridao_em_que_a_noite_esconde: Darkness at which night hides the map
Config.0_qualquer_escuridao_ja_esconde_1: 0 = any darkness hides it; 1 = never hides it. 0.6 darkens at the end of dusk.
Config.quais_tabelas_aparecem_em_tabela_de: Which tables appear in "Encounter table" in the travel window. None checked = all.
Config.quando_o_tempo_passa_o_que: When time passes, what to do with active effects on characters whose duration has ended (spells, poisons...). Uses the start time and duration Foundry already stores in each effect.
Config.desativar_fica_na_ficha_desligado: Disable (stays on the sheet, turned off)
Config.avisar_o_mestre_quando_efeitos_acabarem: Tell the GM when effects end
Config.luas_cheias_juntas_eclipses_e_noites: Full moons together, eclipses and moonless nights, on the day they happen.
Config.a_cada_lua_nova_eclipse_solar: At each new moon (solar eclipse) and each full moon (lunar eclipse), the chance of an eclipse. The roll is fixed: eclipses always fall on the same days.
Config.eclipse_solar_muda_o_clima_do: Solar eclipse changes the day's weather
Config.no_dia_de_um_eclipse_solar: On the day of a solar eclipse, the regions' weather becomes "Eclipse".
Config.quantos_dias_a_frente_o_mestre: How many days ahead the GM sees and adjusts in the Forecast tab of the weather window.
Config.quando_voce_muda_alguma_opcao_de: When you change a module setting in the settings window and close it, the page reloads by itself. If the changed setting is a world setting, connected players reload too.
Config.com_o_fxmaster_ativo_cada_clima: With FXMaster active, each weather type uses the FXMaster effect chosen for it (Weather tab); without FXMaster, or when this is off, it uses the Foundry effect.
Config.quanto_a_temperatura_de_um_dia: How far a day's temperature can stray from the region's average (in the daily roll and in the weather window's die).
Config.clima_nas_cenas_sem_regiao_propria: Weather in scenes without their own region
Config.cenas_que_nao_escolheram_uma_regiao: Scenes that did not choose a region and have no weather Region drawn. "All": they use the world's default region (except those the GM turned off and those with a hand-picked effect). "Only marked": only those with "Show the weather effect in this scene" (as up to 4.1.0).
Config.chuva_neve_neblina_do_foundry_ou: Rain, snow, fog... (from Foundry or FXMaster) in scenes with their own region, in maps with weather Regions and, per the "Weather in scenes without their own region" option, in the other scenes.
Config.mostra_para_todos_uma_passagem_de: Shows everyone a full-screen passage of time.
Config.o_dia_das_ofertas_diarias_do: Journal da Mesa's daily-offers day advances along with the calendar.
Config.avisa_o_mestre_no_chat_quando: Alerts the GM in chat when a new week starts, to restock the Journal da Mesa shops.
Config.calendario_um_nexus_tentou_ligar_uma: Calendar: a Nexus tried to turn on an anomaly over a whole region, but the "Anomaly covering a whole region" option is off.

Importar.meses_que_so_existem_em_alguns: Months that only exist in some years were imported as months of every year.
Importar.regras_de_bissexto_com_excecoes_viraram: Leap-year rules with exceptions were reduced to the main interval.

Importar.o_calendario_importado_nao_tem_meses: The imported calendar has no months.
Importar.so_se_escolher_nova_pasta: Only if you choose New folder
Importar.0_a_repeticao_e_editada_no: {0}. The repetition is edited in Journal da Mesa.
Importar.para_editar_o_texto_abra_a: To edit the text, open the note. To change the day, drag the note to another day on the calendar.

Editor.o_mundo_precisa_de_pelo_menos: The world needs at least one calendar.
Editor.as_notas_dele_nao_sao_apagadas: Its notes are not deleted: they move to the main calendar. Scenes that used it go back to the main one.
Editor.salve_o_calendario_antes_de_torna: Save the calendar before making it the main one.
Editor.0_agora_e_o_calendario_principal: "{0}" is now the world's main calendar.
Editor.escolha_um_calendario_seu_para_editar: Choose one of your calendars to edit, or start a new one from a template or from a Foundry calendar
Editor.importar_do_mundo_foundry_sistema_e: Import from the world (Foundry, system and modules)
Editor.outra_civilizacao_com_meses_e_eventos: Another civilization, with its own months and events
Editor.calendario_usado_quando_a_cena_nao: Calendar used when the scene doesn't choose another one
Editor.json_do_calendario_da_mesa_simple: JSON from Calendário da Mesa, Simple Calendar, Seasons & Stars, Fantasy-Calendar.com or Foundry/Calendaria
Editor.salvar_este_calendario_num_arquivo_json: Save this calendar to a JSON file
Editor.modelos_e_importacoes_abrem_como_um: Templates and imports open as a new calendar; nothing is saved until you click Save.
Editor.bissexto_a_cada_0_anos_comecando: Leap year every{0} years, starting in year{1}
Editor.os_dias_a_mais_de_cada: The extra days of each month go in the "Days in leap year" column of the months.
Editor.desde_o_inicio_da_era_ano: From the start of the era (year 1)
Editor.sem_eras_todos_os_anos_usam: No eras: every year uses the default suffix.
Editor.ha_eras_com_anos_em_comum: Some eras share years; the one that starts first wins.
Editor.ex_era_do_fogo_sufixo_e: E.g.: "Era of Fire", suffix "E.F.", from 1 to 999, and "Era of the Elements", "E.E.", from 1000 with no end. When counting "from the start", year 1003 of the era that starts in 1000 shows as "4 E.E.".
Editor.muda_o_tempo_do_mundo_para: Changes the world time for everyone (moons, light and events follow). Uses the months and years on this screen, even before saving.
Editor.aparece_a_cada_0_anos_e:
Appears every {0} years
                and stays {1} years, starting in {2}
Editor.comecar_o_ciclo_neste_ano_o: Start the cycle this year (the month exists now)
Editor.meses_aparece_a_cada_0_existe: Months: "Appears every" 0 = exists every year. E.g.: every 7 years, stays 1 year, starting in 1021 → the month only exists in 1021, 1028, 1035... The start is the displayed year.
Editor.o_dia_antes_de_a_proxima: The day before the next season starts
Editor.cada_estacao_vai_do_dia_em: Each season runs from the day it starts until the day before the next one. E.g.: winter on 5 Frost and spring on 21 Rebirth → winter ends on 20 Rebirth. It can cross the year.
Editor.comecar_o_ciclo_hoje_a_lua: Start the cycle today (the moon appears now)
Editor.no_ceu_agora_some_em_0: in the sky now, leaves in {0}
Editor.quanto_tempo_esta_fase_fica_no: How long this phase stays in the sky in each {0}-day cycle
Editor.a_1_fase_e_a_lua: The 1st phase is the new moon. The phases split the cycle in proportion to their relative duration (e.g.: a full moon with 2 lasts twice as long).
Editor.deslocamento_em_que_dia_do_mundo: Offset = on which world day the moon was new. "Appears every" 0 = always in the sky. The start is counted in displayed years (e.g.: 1023), in months since year 0 or in world days — the ⌖ button starts the cycle today.
Editor.o_tempo_do_mundo_e_guardado: World time is stored in seconds. Changing months, week or hours changes the date shown for the same moment; notes stay on the same absolute day.
Editor.esse_arquivo_nao_e_um_json: That file is not valid JSON.
Editor.nada_foi_salvo_ainda_revise_no: Nothing has been saved yet. Review it in the editor and click Save calendar.
Editor.nao_achei_outro_calendario_neste_mundo: No other calendar found in this world. Export the JSON in the other module and use Import file.
Editor.0_meses_1_dias_no_ano_2: {0} months, {1} days in the year, {2}-day week, {3} hours per day.
Editor.as_0_notas_deste_calendario_continuam: The {0} notes of this calendar keep the same date (e.g.: "5 Ember" stays "5 Ember")
Editor.0_nota_s_ajustada_s_para: {0} note(s) adjusted to stay on the same date.

Historico.cria_ou_atualiza_o_diario_historico: Creates or updates the 'Histórico da campanha' Journal Entry
Historico.aqui_ficam_os_0_registros_mais: The {0} most recent records are kept here; older ones are in the "Histórico da campanha" Journal Entry, Arquivo page.
Historico.nada_registrado_ainda_o_historico_se: Nothing recorded yet. The history fills itself in as days, events, travel, weather and sessions go by.

Tabelas.todas_as_tabelas_aparecem_na_janela: All tables appear in the travel window.
Tabelas.marque_as_tabelas_que_devem_aparecer: Check the tables that should appear in "Encounter table" in the travel window. With none checked, all of them appear.
Tabelas.nenhuma_tabela_no_mundo_crie_em: No tables in the world. Create them in Tables (the roll tables tab).
Tabelas.quais_aparecem_aqui_configuracoes_calend: Which ones appear here: Settings → Calendário da Mesa → Travel encounter tables.
Tabelas.passar_os_dias_separadamente_narracao_de: Play the days separately (narrate each moment and keep watches at night)
Tabelas.cada_dia_e_avancado_pelo_mestre: The GM advances each day. When the clock reaches watch time, the button to set up the watches unlocks (2 hours each).
Tabelas.sem_o_dia_a_dia_o: Without day by day: time jumps straight through the travel hours and the stops to sleep. The summary goes to the chat and the history.

Divindades.nenhuma_divindade_do_journal_da_mesa: No Journal da Mesa deity found; type the name below.
Divindades.vira_uma_nota_que_se_repete: Becomes a note that repeats every year, linked to the deity's page. It appears on the calendar and in Journal da Mesa.
